active_family: 295 fixed-horizon joint conditional-law model with future control-state sequence
current_bottleneck: The fixed-horizon joint-law family can now allocate conditional spread, but it still cannot control the center-path dynamics. 295a restored coverage and short-horizon width, yet mean reversion collapsed completely and level-law fidelity stayed weak. The family is learning volatility allocation better than path-shape allocation.
last_result_summary: Iteration 156 ran 295a-v0. The future control-state sequence baseline scored 3/11. It was the first current-line model to restore strong coverage across all horizons, with good calibration and preserved cross-cell structure, but it failed to become a usable path-shape controller: MR collapsed to zero, level KS stayed near-dead, and worst-cell cointegration still failed.
next_step_recommendation: Do paradigm-shift analysis. Decide whether to archive the fixed-horizon one-stage joint-law line as capped and move to a hybrid program that combines a stronger structural center-path mechanism with a learned stochastic path law.
